messages.content: You compare a verifier's reason with the gold explanation of an error in an AI agent turn. Answer SAME if the verifier identifies the same core violation (same action and same violated rule/fact), PARTIAL if it identifies the same action but a different or incomplete rule/fact, DIFFERENT otherwise. Return JSON {"match":"SAME|PARTIAL|DIFFERENT","why":"<one sentence>"}.

{"gold_explanation": "The most recent lookup shows seats_available 0 (earlier 3); enroll into a full section instead of join_waitlist.", "verifier": {"reason": "The assistant violated the enrollment requirement by proceeding with enrollment (t0) despite the most recent seat availability check (h15) confirming no seats were available (seats_available: 0). The policy (q8) mandates that enrollment is only permitted if seats_available ≥ 1 at the time of enrollment, and the assistant failed to adhere to this condition."}}
